title: DecisionRequest
description: A structured request for a user decision (version 1). Agents put an array of these in the optional `decisions` field of an intake, plan or investigation result. The router embeds them in the escalation comment as a `factory-decision:v1` marker so Cezarium can show the question, its details and the suggested paths, and post the answer back. `unresolvedQuestions` stays the human-readable summary and the fallback for consumers that predate this format.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the issue (for example `storage-owner`). Answers refer to it.

question.description: The single focused question, one sentence.

context.description: Observed problem and relevant evidence (Markdown). Why the repository and issue could not settle it.

tradeoffs.description: What it costs or risks, and what it makes easier.

recommendedOptionId.description: The option id the agent recommends. Must match an entry in `options`.
